_note: Luyện diễn đạt lại (v87, Claude soạn, chưa giáo viên kiểm). s = câu trong câu hỏi; a = câu trong bài cùng ý (diễn đạt lại); w = 3 câu bẫy: trùng từ với câu hỏi nhưng khác ý, hoặc chỉ đúng một phần; p = các cặp từ được thay; why = giải thích tiếng Việt.

items.s: The number of people cycling to work has risen sharply.
items.a: Commuting by bike has become far more popular in recent years.
w: The number of people who work in bicycle factories has risen sharply.
Cycling to work is sharply more dangerous than it used to be.
People who cycle to work have risen earlier than other commuters.
items.why: Cùng ý: nhiều người đạp xe đi làm hơn. Câu bẫy giữ từ 'risen sharply' / 'cycling' nhưng nói chuyện khác.

items.s: Children who read for pleasure tend to do better at school.
items.a: Pupils who enjoy books in their free time usually achieve higher grades.
w: Children are more likely to read when school is enjoyable.
Schools that buy more books tend to attract better pupils.
Reading at school is less pleasant than reading at home.
p: enjoy books in their free time
items.why: Ý: đọc vì thích → học tốt hơn. Câu bẫy đảo nguyên nhân – kết quả hoặc đổi chủ thể.

items.s: The museum was unable to attract enough visitors.
items.a: Attendance at the gallery remained disappointingly low.
w: The museum attracted too many visitors for its small rooms.
Visitors were unable to find the museum easily.
The museum did not want to attract more visitors.
items.why: Ít khách đến. 'unable' (không làm được) khác 'did not want' (không muốn).

items.s: Most experts now agree that the theory was wrong.
items.a: The majority of specialists have come to reject the original idea.
w: A few experts still believe the theory is correct.
Experts have always agreed about the theory.
Most experts now agree on a new theory about the same topic.
p: agree that the theory was wrong
have come to reject the original idea
items.why: 'now agree … was wrong' = 'have come to reject'. Câu 'a few still believe' có thể đúng nhưng không cùng ý.

items.s: The new bridge has reduced travel time between the two towns.
items.a: Since the crossing opened, journeys from one town to the other are shorter.
w: The new bridge took a long time to build between the two towns.
Travel between the two towns has increased since the bridge opened.
The two towns have reduced the money spent on bridges.
items.why: Thời gian đi ngắn hơn. 'Travel has increased' là nhiều chuyến hơn, không phải nhanh hơn.

items.s: Farmers were initially reluctant to try the new method.
items.a: At first, growers were unwilling to experiment with the technique.
w: Farmers were the first to try the new method.
Farmers found the new method difficult to learn at first.
The new method was initially used only on small farms.
items.why: reluctant = unwilling (không muốn). 'difficult to learn' là khó, không phải không muốn.

items.s: The company's profits fell for the first time in ten years.
items.a: After a decade of growth, the firm's earnings declined.
w: The company has made a profit every year for ten years.
The company was founded ten years ago and soon made a loss.
Profits fell for ten years in a row.
p: for the first time in ten years
items.why: Lần đầu giảm sau 10 năm. 'Fell for ten years in a row' là giảm liên tục 10 năm: ngược ý.

items.s: Using public transport is cheaper than running a car.
items.a: Taking buses and trains costs less than owning a private vehicle.
w: Public transport is more comfortable than a private car.
Running a car is cheaper in the countryside.
The price of public transport has gone up more than the price of cars.
items.why: So sánh chi phí: rẻ hơn = costs less. Câu 'price has gone up more' nói về mức tăng, không phải rẻ hơn.

items.s: The species is now found only on one island.
items.a: Today, the animal survives in a single location.
w: The species was first found on one island.
One island has more species than any other.
The species can now be found on many islands.
items.why: 'only' quan trọng: chỉ còn một nơi. 'first found' là nơi phát hiện đầu tiên.

items.s: Staff complained about the lack of training.
items.a: Employees were unhappy that they had not been taught the necessary skills.
w: Staff complained that the training was too long.
The training was cancelled because of staff complaints.
Staff were trained to deal with complaints.
p: had not been taught the necessary skills
items.why: lack of = không có. Câu bẫy giữ 'training', 'complaints' nhưng nói chuyện khác.

items.s: The government plans to ban plastic bags next year.
items.a: Authorities intend to prohibit single-use carrier bags within twelve months.
w: The government banned plastic bags last year.
The government is planning to make plastic bags cheaper.
Shops have asked the government to provide more plastic bags.
items.why: Thì quan trọng: 'plans to … next year' là chưa xảy ra; 'banned last year' đã xảy ra.

items.s: Older people are more likely to suffer from loneliness.
items.a: Isolation is a bigger risk for the elderly than for younger adults.
w: Older people prefer to spend time alone.
Loneliness makes people age more quickly.
Younger adults are more likely to visit older relatives.
items.why: Khả năng bị cô đơn cao hơn. 'prefer to spend time alone' là thích ở một mình, không phải khổ vì cô đơn.

items.s: The findings cast doubt on earlier research.
items.a: The results call into question what previous studies had concluded.
w: The findings confirm what earlier research had shown.
Earlier research doubted that the findings were possible.
The researchers doubted their own findings.
items.why: cast doubt on = call into question (khiến nghi ngờ). 'confirm' là ngược ý.

items.s: The scheme was abandoned because it was too expensive.
items.a: The project was dropped owing to its high cost.
w: The scheme became more expensive after it was abandoned.
The scheme was cheap, so it was soon forgotten.
The scheme continued despite its high cost.
items.why: Bỏ vì đắt. 'despite its high cost' là vẫn tiếp tục: ngược ý.

items.s: Few people realise how much water is used to produce food.
items.a: The quantity of water needed in agriculture is widely underestimated.
w: Few people use water carefully when they cook.
Most people know that food production uses a lot of water.
Producing food uses less water than people think.
p: how much water is used to produce food
the quantity of water needed in agriculture
items.why: Ít người biết → bị đánh giá thấp. 'Most people know' là ngược; 'less water than people think' cũng ngược.

items.s: The method has not yet been tested on humans.
items.a: Trials so far have involved only animals.
w: The method was tested on humans and failed.
Scientists do not plan to test the method on animals.
The method is not safe for humans.
p: not yet been tested on humans
trials so far have involved only animals
items.why: Chưa thử trên người (chỉ trên động vật). 'not safe' là kết luận khác: bài không nói.

items.s: Demand for the product exceeded the company's expectations.
items.a: Far more customers wanted the item than the firm had predicted.
w: The company expected demand to fall.
The product exceeded customers' expectations.
The company could not produce what it had planned.
p: far more customers wanted … than predicted
items.why: Nhu cầu vượt dự đoán của công ty. 'exceeded customers' expectations' là sản phẩm tốt hơn mong đợi của khách: khác chủ thể.

items.s: The architect drew inspiration from traditional houses.
items.a: The designer's ideas were influenced by local building styles of the past.
w: The architect designed several traditional houses.
Traditional houses were drawn by the architect as a student.
The architect wanted to replace traditional houses.
p: local building styles of the past
items.why: drew inspiration from = lấy cảm hứng. Câu bẫy dùng 'drew' theo nghĩa vẽ.

items.s: There is little evidence that the diet improves health.
items.a: Claims about the eating plan's benefits are largely unsupported.
w: There is clear evidence that the diet is harmful.
The diet has little effect on weight.
Health experts have little interest in the diet.
items.why: Thiếu bằng chứng ≠ có bằng chứng là hại. Đây là bẫy hay gặp của NOT GIVEN / FALSE.

items.s: The town's population doubled over two decades.
items.a: In twenty years, the number of residents grew to twice its original size.
w: The town's population was double that of its neighbour.
Two decades ago, the town was twice as large.
The population grew by two per cent each decade.
p: grew to twice its original size
items.why: Tăng gấp đôi trong 20 năm. 'twice as large two decades ago' là trước kia lớn hơn: ngược.

items.s: Critics argue that the policy benefits only the wealthy.
items.a: Opponents claim that the measure serves the interests of the rich alone.
w: Critics argue that the policy costs the wealthy too much.
The wealthy have criticised the policy.
Supporters argue that the policy helps everyone.
p: serves the interests of the rich alone
items.why: Người phản đối nói chính sách chỉ có lợi cho người giàu. Câu 'the wealthy have criticised' đổi người phát biểu.

items.s: The disease spread rapidly because of poor hygiene.
items.a: Inadequate sanitation allowed the illness to move quickly through the population.
w: Poor hygiene was rapidly improved after the disease spread.
The disease spread slowly despite poor hygiene.
Hygiene became poor because the disease spread.
items.why: Vệ sinh kém → bệnh lan nhanh. Câu bẫy đảo chiều nguyên nhân.

items.s: The idea was dismissed when it was first proposed.
items.a: Initially, the suggestion was rejected out of hand.
w: The idea was first proposed by someone who was later dismissed from the job.
The idea was accepted immediately.
Nobody proposed the idea until much later.
items.why: dismissed = gạt đi (không phải sa thải). Câu bẫy dùng nghĩa 'bị đuổi việc'.

items.s: Tourism has had a negative impact on the local environment.
items.a: The influx of visitors has damaged the surrounding natural habitat.
w: Tourists have a negative opinion of the local environment.
Tourism has improved the local economy.
The local environment has reduced the number of tourists.
items.why: Du lịch gây hại môi trường. 'negative opinion' là ý kiến của khách, không phải tác động.

items.s: The library is closed to the public on Sundays.
items.a: Visitors cannot use the library at weekends except on Saturdays.
w: The library is only open to the public on Sundays.
On Sundays, the library closes early.
The public library was closed on a Sunday.
p: closed to the public on Sundays
visitors cannot use … except on Saturdays
items.why: Đóng ngày Chủ nhật. 'closes early' là vẫn mở một phần.

items.s: Participants were asked to keep a record of what they ate.
items.a: Those taking part had to write down their meals in a diary.
w: Participants kept the food records for the researchers.
Participants were asked to eat what the researchers recorded.
Participants had to remember what they ate without writing it down.
p: keep a record of what they ate
write down their meals in a diary
items.why: Ghi lại món đã ăn. Câu bẫy giữ 'record', 'ate' nhưng đổi việc làm.

items.s: The device is unlikely to be available to consumers in the near future.
items.a: It will probably be years before ordinary people can buy the gadget.
w: Consumers are unlikely to want the device.
The device will soon be cheaper for consumers.
The device is no longer available to consumers.
p: unlikely to be available in the near future
it will probably be years before … can buy
items.why: Chưa sớm có bán. 'no longer available' là từng có, nay hết: khác ý.

items.s: Rising sea levels pose a threat to coastal cities.
items.a: Urban areas near the shore are endangered by the steady rise of the oceans.
w: Coastal cities have caused sea levels to rise.
Sea levels are rising faster near cities.
Coastal cities pose a threat to the oceans.
p: the steady rise of the oceans
items.why: Câu bị động đảo chủ ngữ nhưng cùng ý. Câu bẫy đổi ai đe doạ ai.

items.s: Researchers have yet to explain why the birds migrate at night.
items.a: The reason for the species' nocturnal journeys remains a mystery to scientists.
w: Researchers have explained why the birds migrate at night.
The birds migrate at night to avoid researchers.
Researchers study the birds only at night.
items.why: 'have yet to' = chưa. Hay bị đọc nhầm thành 'đã'.

items.s: The course is suitable for complete beginners.
items.a: No previous experience is needed to join the class.
w: The course is completely full with beginners.
Beginners should complete another course first.
The course is suitable only for experienced learners.
items.why: Ai cũng học được, không cần biết trước. Câu bẫy dùng 'complete' theo nghĩa khác.

items.s: The two languages share a common origin.
items.a: Both tongues developed from the same ancestor language.
w: The two languages are commonly spoken together.
The two languages share many words borrowed from each other.
One language was originally spoken by more people.
p: developed from the same ancestor language
items.why: Cùng gốc. 'borrowed from each other' là vay mượn: khác với cùng gốc.

items.s: Funding for the project was withdrawn after two years.
items.a: The sponsors stopped providing money for the scheme once two years had passed.
w: The project took two years to find funding.
Funding for the project was doubled after two years.
The project was withdrawn from the competition after two years.
items.why: Rút tiền tài trợ. 'project was withdrawn from the competition' là rút dự án, không phải rút tiền.
